data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The nocturnal UHI is a thermal-mass battery discharge: urban impervious surfaces with high heat capacity and thermal mass absorb daytime solar radiation and store it as sensible heat, then release it slowly after sunset via longwave radiation, keeping city air warmer than the countryside where vegetation and low thermal mass cool rapidly. The cross-city night-time gap is modulated most strongly by building height and street canyon geometry: deeper canyons reduce sky view factor, trapping longwave radiation and slowing nocturnal cooling, so cities with denser, taller built environments exhibit larger nocturnal UHI gaps.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If measured thermal storage in urban fabric is insufficient to account for the observed nocturnal temperature surplus","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If sky view factor variation across cities shows no correlation with nocturnal UHI magnitude","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If anthropogenic heat emissions at night dominate over stored heat release","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If wind speed differences rather than radiative geometry explain the cross-city variation","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"During the day, concrete, asphalt, and masonry absorb solar energy and store it as sensible heat due to high thermal mass and heat capacity. After sunset the countryside cools quickly due to low thermal mass and efficient longwave radiative loss to the open sky, while the city releases stored heat slowly. Street canyons with low sky view factor impede longwave radiative cooling, prolonging the release. Cities with taller buildings and denser street canyons have lower sky view factors, so their nocturnal cooling is more suppressed, producing a larger UHI gap.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
